dataset: Climatology endpoint, twenty year monthly normals
licence: CC BY 4.0; 'There are no restrictions on the use, access, and/or download of data from the NASA POWER Project' (AWS Open Data Registry entry)
attribution: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project, funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program

freshness.reason: older than 1825 days but still the best that exists, so it publishes with its date

units.tmaxExtreme: C, highest value in the twenty year period, not a mean daily maximum
units.tminExtreme: C, lowest value in the twenty year period, not a mean daily minimum

meaning: Monthly climate normals for one model grid cell per city, on a single twenty year period so that cities inside a country can be compared with each other. Only tmean is a normal; the two extreme fields describe the worst the period produced and are never scored as though they were a typical day.

notCovered.station: Not a weather station record. A reader wanting the official station series wants the national meteorological service.
notCovered.meanDailyRange: The provider publishes extremes rather than mean daily maxima and minima on this endpoint, so no page here may state a typical daytime high or overnight low. That needs the daily endpoint reduced per city.
notCovered.extremes: The extreme fields are the whole period, undated. Nothing here says which year produced them or how often they recur.
notCovered.seaTemperature: Not in this capture, and a beach page that needs it needs another source.
